title: Deposit-Program Delivery Charge Line — Ridgeline Special Order Services Tool Card
content:
**Scope.** The home delivery charge on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent of the order total (a deposit at order, the balance before release) that Ridgeline has delivered to the customer's address and that is not linked to an installation contract. The charge is due once the order has been delivered, and it is billed once on the order as a home delivery fee line.

**Business effect.** Billing the charge adds one home delivery fee line, dated today, to the order's ledger and raises the order's balance due by the charge; the customer sees the delivery charge on the order and the higher balance due.

## Tool: `bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad`

**Capability.** Bills the home delivery charge on a deposit-program special order that Ridgeline has delivered to the customer's address: one call adds one home delivery fee line, dated today, and raises the balance due by the charge.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the tool name `bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad` and the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `special_order_id` | the reference number of the delivered special order, as returned by the special order lookup for this customer | identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `delivery_charge` | the home delivery charge to bill | US dollars as a plain number with 2 decimal places (for example 96.40); the tool rounds to the nearest cent |

Neither parameter has an enumerated set of values.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence that begins "Delivery charge billed" when the line was recorded, carrying the fee line reference number (text starting "sodlv"), the special order number, the charge billed (US dollars, 2 decimals) and the order's new balance due (US dollars, 2 decimals, negative when money is owed back).

## Reference questions

**Does one call bill more than one line?** No. Each call adds one home delivery fee line on the order named.

**Illustration (hypothetical values).** Calling with `delivery_charge` 96.40 on an order whose balance due was 0.00 returns a sentence reporting a charge of 96.40 and a balance due of 96.40.
